article.title: Local Foodies Chime In on S&S
article.author: Connie S. Sewer
article.content:
Members of the local food club visited Scoops and Smiles for an evening of tasting and conversation.

The group sampled six flavors and gave top marks to our smooth custard base, house-made toppings, and generous waffle cones. Mint chip narrowly won the unofficial flavor vote.

We loved hearing their ideas and sharing the story behind our shop. Thanks to everyone who joined us!
